originalDescriptionVerbatim: From lane B's syzygy-bpyt.65 plan (2026-10-28): scripts/clean_build.mjs does not refuse a tsconfig whose ts.getParsedCommandLineOfConfigFile parse carries recoverable errors (parsed.errors, e.g. a missing extends target). Today such a tree reaches tsc -b and fails there, after the dists are removed. Refuse it inside visit, before anything is removed, with a message naming the file and the first error. Refuses nothing tsc -b accepts (it only moves the refusal before removal), so check that claim with a base-vs-head refusal matrix; owner notice on syzygy-bpyt.10 only if the matrix shows a newly refused tree. After syzygy-bpyt.65.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 1. Preserve the WHOLE original description/outcome verbatim in design and leave the canonical description/title/priority/type/owner/labels/notes/comments/status and sole syzygy-bpyt parent-child dependency untouched; original structured AC prefix is exactly empty. Verify .65's actual closed/merged state; do not reopen/reshape .65/.77 or create graph changes. Keep .73 open through the later implementation, review and lawful landing.
acceptance.state: Local preservation and prerequisite observations retained; ROOT owns canonical record.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 2. At the later allocation, bind the current clean base/head, runtime/lock identity, exact owned paths, callers and actual authorization/limits to primary sources. ROOT supplies one accountable script+test owner and refreshes exact PR/path custody, including a serial handoff for PR #774's product-build.test.ts and any overlapping successor. No unauthorized package/lock/tier/timeout/test-kit/governed-file changes; no blanket scripts/app preparation freeze or new routine-choice owner gate.
acceptance.state: Allocated exact source/test/new-evidence scope and private lock/cache identities retained.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 3. In scripts/clean_build.mjs retain the parsed TypeScript result and refuse a recoverable nonempty parsed.errors result inside visit, before ANY project's dist removal or tsc spawn. Name the visited config file and the FIRST diagnostic's actual message, including chained message text. Preserve the current unrecoverable callback and error context; do not let an undefined/unreadable parse silently accept or reach removal. Document exact diagnostics and exit behavior instead of calling the change wholly byte-preserving.
acceptance.state: Implemented and exercised; diagnostics/exit/effects explicitly recorded.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 4. Reproduce missing extends and circular extends at the real existing clean-build child-process seam. Extend product-build.test.ts's scratch fixture/table with the two justified regression cases; include multiple diagnostics to pin first selection and a single-error case to kill a >1 threshold bypass. Observe relevant regression assertions FAIL with the frozen base/bypassed guard and PASS with the final script, with actual collected/executed cases and intended assertion failures. An implementation-token scan or mocked parsed object does not satisfy this item.
acceptance.state: Two real-seam cases; base failures, head pass and executable guard bypass retained.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 5. For direct named, transitive and multi-named graph failures, seed every relevant project's dist and unrelated/outside-control sentinels, capture the complete pre/post tree, and retain representative OS process/deletion traces. Prove no dist removal attempt and no tsc execution on the intended early-refusal path. Record old wrapper/native tsc failure exits, diagnostics, removed sentinels and any partial emitted effects independently; nonzero exit alone or final sentinel survival alone is insufficient proof of zero removals.
acceptance.state: Three representative full-argv process/deletion traces and complete tree images retained.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 6. Produce one frozen base-versus-head refusal matrix over the SAME restored case inputs with exact subject/script/test/tool/corpus hashes, runtime versions, argv/cwd/timeouts, raw outputs and per-file results. Add independent native tsc -b outcomes for each newly handled parse case. Enumerate newly refused, newly accepted, changed-message, changed-exit, moved-before-removal, still-native-failure and unchanged rows. Establish the incremental “refuses nothing native tsc accepts” claim for the NEW check; enumerate the wrapper's pre-existing stricter grammar separately. Do not silently narrow the original claim or turn Unknown into zero.
acceptance.state: Finite matrix complete: 75 scratch rows + 2 workspace builds; independent native outcomes and categories retained.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 7. The matrix covers missing/deep/array/package extends, circular extends, multiple and single recoverable errors, invalid compiler option/type and relevant grammar at the pinned TS version; strict malformed own JSON/comments, missing/unreadable config, callback/unrecoverable reachability, inherited null output-option keys, reference cycles/non-composite projects and all existing old refusal rows/backslash behavior are retained. A truly unreachable native callback case is reported with its boundary/limitation, not manufactured by a mock. Ordinary source/compiler failures after a successful config parse remain the existing tsc path; do not broaden this repair into all compilation preflight or change raw-reference grammar.
acceptance.state: Grammar/control corpus retained; callback/chained-message reachability limitations explicit.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 8. For accepted inputs, independently compare complete build/build:poc output path sets and BYTES, including .tsbuildinfo, under the same runtime/input identity. Preserve transitive graph discovery, normalized/deduplicated project behavior, referenced-only composite requirement, dist roots, old early-refusal strings/exits outside the required parse-error precedence, unrelated projects, stale/poisoned/removed-source cleanup and native spawn/status propagation. Include existing valid inherited and unreferenced non-composite controls; enumerate every residual or changed precedence explicitly.
acceptance.state: Accepted fixture and actual full build byte parity retained; native ordinary compiler-failure boundary retained.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 9. Execute valid, invalid, restored-valid, altered-prose/whitespace/key-order and predicate-bypass controls with real grammar. Harmless top-level explanatory strings cannot drive admission/refusal; invalid compilerOptions text remains an actual parser case. Restoring an extends target/cycle must build, repeated early refusals preserve the initial tree, and repeat accepted runs preserve deterministic outputs. Run separate serial private fixtures; do not claim protection against concurrent edits/builds, post-validation I/O failure or rollback of later tsc effects, which this change does not implement.
acceptance.state: Valid/invalid/restored/repeated/prose/format controls retained; concurrency and rollback excluded.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 10. Meet verification rule 6 for EACH new predicate/assertion with exact real executable mutations: bypass/drop the parsed-error guard, put refusal after removal, require >1 errors, use a later diagnostic, omit file context and omit diagnostic text as applicable. Retain old/new fragments, reachable tested commit/ref, subject and tool/fixture/corpus digests, successful controls, meaningful executed denominator and the specific killing assertion; restore exact bytes afterwards. Import/parse crashes, zero tests, unmatched edits, generic timeout or printed mutation tokens are not kills. Explain any genuine equivalence/survivor without suppressing the failure. M0 behavior is Unknown until that execution occurs.
acceptance.state: Six exact executable mutants killed with meaningful two-case denominator; prior adapter failure retained uncredited.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 11. State test growth from actual base/head collection and assertions. FIRST actual is +0~0-0, runtime/tests/builds/probes/mutants 0. Source baseline is static 10 standalone tests +15 parameter rows (25 expected cases, uncollected), with a +2-case forecast and no new file. Recompute after #774/source drift and justify any count change. Reuse the existing E2E behavior species and task-specific differential adapters; add no duplicate source-scan/type gate or permanent test per matrix variant, and execute no frozen historical wrapper that appends logs.
acceptance.state: Actual collected delta +2 ~15 -0 cases; +1 assertion call site; no new permanent test file.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 12. Before authorized NodeNext/test execution, complete npm ci in the allocated worktree at the exact lockfile identity; honor private cache/offline namespace and private HOME/TMPDIR/fixture/process-cleanup requirements. Run npx --no-install vitest run --project e2e apps/three-surface-poc/src/product-build.test.ts plus the new task-owned differential/mutant commands. Keep every attempted command/exit/raw output and exact subject. Use npm run check while working and one final npm run check:all in a clean clone; it includes the canonical battery via npm run check:battery, whose live PROJECT-STATUS.md block is read at the tested commit, including check_governance and --selftest. Serialize broad runs on /home/orca/.tmp/syzygy-full-suite-20261104.lock; never kill/restart another gate or self-classify a failed run away. Retain independent ROOT/CI capture, file/test/case denominators, hashes and cleanup proof; local/emitter evidence and hosted integration are distinct claims.
acceptance.state: Offline installs/scoped/working gates done. Final exact clean-clone check:all and independent ROOT READY/capture remain pending.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 13. Update the script header, new task evidence/verification/readiness/change record and required existing review/index entries in the same logical change; keep historical .65 tools/results, raw reviews, bound acts/specs and unrelated code immutable. State initial and reviewer-confirmed CC-REV-1 classes (initial class 3; assess actual 1/4/6, no automatic inheritance from .65's wider PR) and all seven CC-BAR-5 floors. Freeze the exact subject and get a fresh independent reviewer with only the artifact, governing references and this AC; retain raw output verbatim, exact verdict and every finding's disposition. Reviewer-authored semantic fixes require another fresh independent review of the resulting head.
acceptance.state: Header/evidence/change record prepared. Final fresh independent review, classes/floor confirmation and raw verdict remain pending.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 14. Preserve the original new-refusal notice condition and obey the independently applicable GP-Q0 notice predicate. Enumerate any newly refused trees on syzygy-bpyt.10; for confirmed class 3 (or 1/4, or class 6 removing an endpoint), ROOT also gives the required non-blocking notice for moved refusals/diagnostic/exit/effect changes even if membership is unchanged. This is not an owner question or authority grant. An unlisted gate-membership change, scope/security/privacy/retention/normative-contract change or authoritative contradiction stops at its ACTUAL governing owner boundary; do not invent a new answer or infer it from .65's review/bead/plan.
acceptance.state: No new membership found in finite corpus. ROOT class-3 non-blocking notice still required; owner boundary preserved.

acceptance.canonicalTextVerbatim: 15. Complete the exact implementation and evidence through a lawful ROOT-owned PR/handoff, retained independent confirmation and current hosted required checks checks/node for the tested/landing tree. Because product-build.test.ts lies under apps/three-surface-poc/src, do not merge the cohesive fix until BOTH actual syzygy-1z3.22 owner judgment and syzygy-1z3.25 cycle report conditions in the 2026-11-03 item-4 direction are satisfied (or a real later owner direction changes them). Preparation remains allowed. Recheck custody/authority/hold status before landing, account for any merge/rebase subject change, preserve unrelated work and enumerate remaining limitations. ROOT alone records notice/lifecycle/closure after the WHOLE outcome, not the static FIRST packet, is complete.
